image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vibrant yellow-orange coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus) growing on a forest floor. The fungus features a dense cluster of upright, cylindrical branches that divide repeatedly into finer tips, resembling marine coral. It is surrounded by green moss, dark decaying leaves, and small twigs. The lighting is natural and diffuse, highlighting the matte texture of the fungal branches.
